items.title: Greetings through the day
items.theme: greetings: morning, daytime, evening and thanks

phrases.note: With friends, just おはよう (ohayō).
Use it from late morning until early evening.

phrases.text: ありがとうございます

phrases.meaning: how are you? (literally: are you well?)
phrases.note: Used when you haven't seen someone for a while, not every day.

dialogue.meaning: Good evening, Mr or Ms Tanaka.

dialogue.text: あ、こんばんは。お元気ですか。
dialogue.meaning: Oh, good evening. How are you?

dialogue.text: はい、元気です。ありがとうございます。

practice.question: It's 8 a.m. and you meet your neighbour. What do you say?
practice.answer: おはようございます (ohayō gozaimasu)

practice.question: Someone asks お元気ですか (o-genki desu ka). How do you reply politely?
practice.answer: はい、元気です。ありがとうございます。(Hai, genki desu. Arigatō gozaimasu.)

practice.question: It's 7 p.m. How do you greet a shop owner?
Why add さん (san) after Tanaka?
practice.answer: It is a polite title, like Mr or Ms. Never use it with your own name.

items.say_aloud: Say the right greeting for right now, then add ありがとうございます (arigatō gozaimasu). Say both three times, slowly.

notes: First daily pack, so it starts with survival basics: greetings through the day. No listening resource added, because none was found and verified in this run.
